title: SimulatorArena: Are User Simulators Reliable Proxies for Multi-Turn Evaluation of AI Assistants?

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of conversations presented to the LLM judge (running the evaluation twice) to prevent the model from defaulting to a specific position.
Comparing how an LLM acting as a rater evaluates its own generated assistant outputs versus the outputs generated by other models, checking for unfair favorable ratings.
